Installs ran with scripts off, so the Prisma client was never generated by @prisma/client's postinstall. Typecheck and build need the generated types.

exclusion.reason: npm run typecheck fails with many TypeScript errors in the repo's own code (e.g. duplicate declarations of screenshots/videos in lib/test-runner.ts, Stripe API version mismatch in lib/stripe.ts, unknown error types in route files), and the build also fails; none of this requires external credentials or services.
